classes.name: 全国人民代表大会代表选举
classes.name_en: National People's Congress deputies, elected by provincial congresses and the armed forces
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 59: the NPC consists of deputies elected by the provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, special administrative regions, and the armed forces; Article 60: five-year term)
classes.finest_note: electoral unit (选举单位): 31 provincial congresses, the Hong Kong and Macao electoral conferences, the Taiwan deputies' consultative election in Fujian, and the armed forces
classes.note: Each provincial-level people's congress elects its share of deputies at a session in the months before the new NPC meets; the Hong Kong and Macao deputies are elected by electoral conferences in each region, the 13 Taiwan deputies by a consultative election held in Beijing, and 281 deputies by the PLA and People's Armed Police. Candidates must outnumber seats by one fifth to one half (Electoral Law art. 30) and win a majority of all deputies of the electing congress (art. 44). The NPC Standing Committee publishes the list of elected deputies by electoral unit; the vote counts are minuted by each electing congress and are not published nationally.

cadence.administered_by: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 (NPC Standing Committee)
cadence.runoff_rule: Seats not filled by a majority of all deputies of the electing congress are filled by another ballot (Electoral Law art. 44)

classes.name: 中华人民共和国主席、副主席选举
classes.name_en: President and Vice President, elected by the National People's Congress
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 62(4): the NPC elects the President and Vice President)
classes.note: The NPC elects the Chairman (主席, President) and Vice Chairman of the People's Republic by secret ballot at the first session of each congress, from a single candidate nominated by the session presidium. The office was left vacant from 1968 and abolished by the 1975 and 1978 constitutions; the 1982 constitution restored it, with the first election on 18 June 1983. The presidium's announcements (公告) name the elected; Xinhua's dispatch on each vote, carried by government sites, gives the deputies present and the result.

cadence.administered_by: 全国人民代表大会主席团 (Presidium of the National People's Congress session)

classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 62(5): the NPC decides the Premier on the President's nomination)
classes.note: A vote of the full NPC on a single nominee, held the day after the presidential election. The same sitting confirms the vice premiers, state councilors, and ministers by a block vote (决定任命), which the census counts with the Premier.

cadence.administered_by: 全国人民代表大会主席团 (Presidium of the National People's Congress session)

classes.note: The chair, vice chairs, secretary-general, and about 170 members of the NPC Standing Committee, the chair of the Central Military Commission (since 1983), and the director of the National Supervisory Commission (since 2018), each elected at the first session of an NPC. The Standing Committee members are chosen from a list with a few more candidates than seats (差额选举).

classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 101)

classes.name: 县级人民代表大会代表直接选举
classes.name_en: County, county-level city, and city district congress deputies, directly elected
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 97: deputies of counties, cities not divided into districts, and city districts are directly elected by the voters)
classes.finest_note: constituency (选区) of one to three seats, drawn by residence or by work unit (Electoral Law art. 24)
classes.disposition_reason: Each county election committee posts the elected deputies (当选代表名单) by constituency on paper notices and sometimes its own site; candidate vote counts are not published, and the NPC reports only national totals of voters and deputies for each round.
classes.note: Direct election of county deputies began under the 1979 Electoral Law (before then county congresses were elected by township congresses). Constituencies elect one to three deputies by majority of votes cast with at least half the registered voters voting; candidates must outnumber seats by one third to double (arts. 30 and 44). Terms went from three to five years in 1993 (counties) and rounds are now staggered over about eighteen months: the 2021-2022 round elected 670,563 county deputies, with 921 million voters (86.49% of those registered). The next round started in 2026.

cadence.administered_by: 县级选举委员会 (county election committees, under the county standing committee)
cadence.runoff_rule: Seats unfilled by a majority go to another ballot won by the most votes with at least one third of the ballots (art. 44)

classes.disposition_reason: Announced by each county congress's presidium, usually without vote counts, across 2,846 separate congresses with no compilation.

classes.name: 地方各级人民法院院长、人民检察院检察长选举
classes.name_en: Presidents of local people's courts and chief procurators, elected by congresses at county level and above
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 101: congresses at and above county level elect the presidents of their courts and their chief procurators; a chief procurator's election needs the approval of the standing committee one level up)
classes.disposition_reason: Elected on single-candidate ballots in each provincial, prefecture, and county congress and announced in presidium notices without vote counts; no body compiles them.

cadence.administered_by: Each people's congress, through its presidium

classes.name: 乡、民族乡、镇人民代表大会代表直接选举
classes.name_en: Township and town congress deputies, directly elected
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 97: deputies of townships, ethnic townships, and towns are directly elected by the voters)
classes.finest_note: constituency (选区) of one to three seats
classes.disposition_reason: Each township election committee posts the elected deputies on notices; candidate vote counts are not published and nobody compiles the 29,592 townships' results.
classes.note: The basic-level elections of 1953-1954 under the 1953 Electoral Law were the first direct elections of the People's Republic; township congresses then elected county deputies. People's communes replaced townships from 1958 to 1983, when township congresses were restored. The 2021-2022 round elected 1,958,884 township deputies with 623 million voters (85.63%). Terms were three years until the 2004 constitutional amendment set five.

cadence.administered_by: 乡级选举委员会 (township election committees, directed by the county standing committee)
cadence.runoff_rule: Seats unfilled by a majority go to another ballot won by the most votes with at least one third of the ballots (art. 44)

dates.quote: 这次换届选举共选出县级人大代表670563名、乡级人大代表1958884名

classes.name: 乡长、镇长的选举
classes.name_en: Township and town heads, elected by the township congress
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Article 101)
classes.disposition_reason: Elected by each township congress and announced on local notices without vote counts; nobody compiles the results.

cadence.administered_by: Each people's congress, through its presidium

classes.name: 村民委员会选举
classes.name_en: Villagers' committees, directly elected
classes.locator: https://sft.xinjiang.gov.cn/xjsft/flfggz/202511/f33edd43e5a149d5a479ec4d0a106ddf.shtml (Article 14: chair, vice chairs, and members directly elected by the villagers for five years; Article 18: candidates must outnumber seats, and a candidate needs a majority with a majority of registered villagers voting)
classes.disposition_reason: Each village's villagers' election committee (村民选举委员会) counts and announces its own result on the spot; township governments and civil affairs offices keep the returns, and no authority publishes candidate votes for the 489,403 villages.
classes.note: Elections began under the trial 1987 Organic Law and became general after the 1998 law. Terms were three years until the 2018 amendment set five, aligned with village party committees; rounds are held province by province over a year or two. The 2025 amendment (in force 2026) keeps the five-year term and has the village party organization or registered villagers nominate candidates.

cadence.administered_by: 村民选举委员会 (each village's election committee, guided by the township government)
cadence.runoff_rule: Seats unfilled by a majority go to another ballot won by the most votes with at least one third of the ballots (art. 18)

classes.name: 社区居民委员会选举
classes.name_en: Urban residents' committees, elected by residents, household representatives, or residents' representatives
classes.locator: http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202510/t20251028_449063.html (Article 14: elected by all eligible residents, by one representative per household, or by residents' representatives; five-year term)
classes.disposition_reason: Run by each community's election committee under the subdistrict office, and in many communities through household or residents' representatives rather than a vote of all residents; results are posted locally and no authority publishes candidate votes.

cadence.administered_by: 社区居民选举委员会 (community election committees, under the subdistrict office)

classes.name: 中国人民解放军选举
classes.name_en: Elections within the People's Liberation Army and People's Armed Police
classes.locator: https://xzfy.moj.gov.cn/c/2021-01-06/487591.shtml (Article 5: the People's Liberation Army holds its elections separately under its own measures)
classes.disposition_reason: Soldiers elect servicemen's congresses (军人代表大会) unit by unit, which in turn elect the armed forces' 281 NPC deputies; the procedure is set by Central Military Commission measures and no results below the list of NPC deputies are published.

match.name_pattern: 军人代表大会|解放军|Servicemen|Liberation Army

classes.name: 全民公决
classes.name_en: Referendums
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Articles 57-78: lawmaking and constitutional amendment rest with the NPC and its Standing Committee; Article 64 has amendments adopted by two thirds of NPC deputies)
classes.disposition_reason: The constitution and laws provide for no referendum or initiative, and none has been held; constitutional amendments are adopted by the NPC alone (Article 64).

classes.name: 中国人民政治协商会议
classes.name_en: Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Preamble: the CPPCC is a broadly representative united-front organization)
classes.disposition_reason: Members are designated by consultation among the parties, people's organizations, and sectors that make it up, not elected; from 1949 to 1954 its plenary session exercised the functions of the NPC, again without elections.

classes.name: 政党内部选举
classes.name_en: Party congresses and internal party elections
classes.locator: https://xzfy.moj.gov.cn/c/2021-01-06/487591.shtml (Article 29: parties and people's organizations nominate candidates jointly or separately; their internal selection is not part of the election)
classes.disposition_reason: Delegate and committee elections of the Communist Party and the eight other legal parties are run under each party's own charter; no state authority runs or certifies them, and the state holds no nominating contests.

classes.name: 中华民国时期国会、国民大会及立法院选举
classes.name_en: Republic of China parliament, National Assembly, and Legislative Yuan elections on the mainland
classes.locator: https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2018-03/22/content_5276318.htm (Preamble: the Revolution of 1911 abolished the feudal monarchy and gave birth to the Republic of China; the People's Republic was founded in 1949)
classes.disposition_reason: Held by the Qing provincial assemblies (1909) and the Republic of China (parliament 1912-1913 and 1918, National Assembly 1947, Legislative Yuan 1948), a state that continues on Taiwan; the People's Republic publishes no results of them and they belong with the Republic of China's record rather than this polity's.
